lead_raw_text:
The structure of Fe2Co2Si12 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 32-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Co in a tetrahedral Si environment, while Fe centers show 10-fold coordination by Si and Si centers adopt 9- and 14-vertex environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Co tetrahedra and between Co tetrahedra and Fe 10-vertex polyhedra, plus edge-sharing between Co tetrahedra.
